rule: `self.m()` / `this.m()` / a bare call to a member of the enclosing type → `Type#m`. If `m` is defined only on a superclass that is in the scan, the callee is `Superclass#m`. | **PHP**: namespace-qualified with dots: `App.Svc#run`; `$this->m()` → `App.Svc#m`; `Cls::m()` → resolved class `#m`.
notes: describe is defined only on the scanned superclass → App.Animal#describe. Dog overrides sound → App.Dog#sound. Inside Animal, $this->sound() names the abstract (body-less) App.Animal#sound, high (Decision 2026-11-09). parent::name() with the parent in the scan resolves to App.Animal#name. String concatenation `.` is not a call. call_type: SPEC lists direct|method without defining them; this corpus uses method for every callee of the form Type#m / recv.m / .m (instance and static member calls) and direct for free functions, bare names and named nested functions.
